plate_comments.name: HandleNerveAtomicStateBump
FlowerLockBitfieldReader_gmd800
plate_comments.comment:
FlowerLock bitfield READER for gmd+0x800 container.
Signature: (gmd, u32* out, u32 hash, u32 bitIdx) -> bool
Hash-probes gmd+0x800 (hash table ptr), capacity at gmd+0x80c.
Bitfield data array at gmd+0x7f8 (slot*0x40 + 0x28 = bitfield word array).
Returns 1 and writes bitfield word to *out if found; falls back to gmd+0x788 (FUN_71000e26a8).
NSO offset: +0xe258c | Ghidra: 0x71000e258c
Session: 2026-06-03

FlowerLock bitfield POPCOUNT for gmd+0x800 container.
Directly accesses gmd+0x800 (hash table) and gmd+0x7f8 (bitfield array).
Returns number of set bits across the FlowerLock bitfield for a route entry.
NSO offset: +0x483574 | Ghidra: 0x7100483574
Session: 2026-06-03

plate_comments.name: CheckFlowerLockBit
plate_comments.comment:
CheckFlowerLockBit (NSO +0x48c1a0)
Reads a specific FlowerLock bit from the gmd+0x800 custom container.
param_1 = pointer to route/node object (contains the FlowerLock hash key reference)
param_2 = bit index to test (signed; -1 = check if gmd has any FlowerLock data)
Calls FUN_71000e258c(gmd, &bitword, hash) to retrieve the bitfield word, then shifts to isolate bit param_2.
Part of the castle-path gate; called in a loop by RouteFlowerLockChecker.
See: docs/re-castle-bowser-gate-findings.md (2026-06-03)

plate_comments.name: ContainerBBoolWriter
plate_comments.comment:
Container-B bool WRITER wrapper (NSO +0x49EA24). Args: (gmd, value, hash).
Checks gmd+0x68 init/lock, delegates to SetContainerBBoolDeferred (+0x1F263FC) on the gmd+8 substruct.
Deferred-write. Grants Royal Seeds / COMPLETE_GAME / INTRO.

plate_comments.name: ContainerACounterWriter
plate_comments.comment:
Container-A counter WRITER (NSO +0x49F648). Args: (gmd, value, hash) -- VALUE FIRST.
Lock-free atomics; deferred-write to dirty queue at gmd+0xf8 (drains at next save).
Grants coins + Wonder-Seed counts/mirrors. Ref: smbw-re-map.md S2/S3.

plate_comments.name: FlowerLock_SyncGmd80_to_ContainerB
plate_comments.comment:
FlowerLock SYNC: reads gmd+0x80 bitfield container (hashes 0x1faf41e5, 0xb9bd745d), syncs bit values to container-B bools via FUN_7101f263fc.
Called at load step 1 of FUN_7101bd7c04 (save-load pipeline).
FlowerLock hashes 0x1faf41e5 / 0xb9bd745d are the container-B gate booleans.
NOTE: reads from gmd+0x80 (different container from gmd+0x800 used by CheckFlowerLockBit).
NSO offset: +0x6b5d6c | Ghidra: 0x71006b5d6c
Session: 2026-06-03

plate_comments.name: WonderSeedRouteGatePredicate
plate_comments.comment:
Wonder-Seed route gate PREDICATE (NSO +0x1787b40). Reads container-A hash 0x390eb960 (current-world Wonder-Seed count) and compares vs a per-gate threshold.
5 mirror hashes (0x21f89ab1/0x8c20ccb7/0xeeff353b/0x390eb960/0xa0e5f253) update in lockstep. Ref: smbw-re-map.md S5.

plate_comments.name: RouteFlowerLockChecker
plate_comments.comment:
RouteFlowerLockChecker (NSO +0x1b70670)
Evaluates the FlowerLock status for a world-map ROUTE entry.
Called as case 7 in FUN_7100377280 (WorldMapRouteGateUpdate) and FUN_71005840f0.
Reads FlowerLock bits from gmd+0x800 container via CheckFlowerLockBit (0x710048c1a0).
For the castle path: all 6 Royal-Seed FlowerLock bits must be set for the path to open.
param_1 = route entry object (lVar9 = the specific route data node).
Returns 1 (open) when all required FlowerLock bits are set.
See: docs/re-castle-bowser-gate-findings.md (2026-06-03)
